messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx for service= model-runner-prod-us-east. Error rate increased from 0.3% -> 25% in 5m. Auto-page on-call.
Nora (eng-oncall): Im taking this. Paging runtime + SRE. Links: https://internal.metrics/alert/1930001111
Vik (eng-runtime): Looking now. Any recent model rollouts or kernel updates?
Riya (eng-sre): No deploys in the last 2h. Kube events show repeated OOMKilled and SIGSEGVs on pods in the gpu-pool-us-east-az1.
Nora (eng-oncall): Copied a failing container log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T18:21:03Z model-runner[pid=7701]: failed to allocate 8192MB: out of memory
2026-03-14T18:21:03Z kernel: [98765.432100] Out of memory: Killed process 7701 (model-runner)
2026-03-14T18:21:03Z model-runner: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9aabbccdde sp 00007fff11223344
```
Vik (eng-runtime): Pattern looks like host OOM during attention workspace allocation for very long requests (seq ~ 4096) combined with high batching concurrency.
Ben (support): Reports coming in: "500 Internal" from both chat and embedding endpoints. Which customers are affected?
Lola (product): Dash shows acute failure for DataSense, Tutorly, and ChatFlow. DataSense is a high-traffic customer on the us-east pool.
Nora (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigations to reduce impact: 1) divert new traffic off the affected pool 2) disable continuous batching 3) inject runtime limits: MAX_SEQ=2048, PER_REQ_MEM=4G, ENABLE_LAZY_KV=true. Vik, can you apply?
Vik (eng-runtime): On it. Executing routing change: `redwoodctl route update --service model-runner --avoid-pool=gpu-pool-us-east-az1` -> applied.
Vik (eng-runtime): Disabling continuous batching: `redwoodctl runtime update model-runner --continuous-batching=false` -> applied.
Vik (eng-runtime): Setting env vars on daemonset: `kubectl set env ds/model-runner MAX_SEQ=2048 PER_REQ_MEM_CAP=4G LAZY_KV=true --context=prod` -> rollout started.
Riya (eng-sre): Cordoning node gpu-pool-us-east-az1-node3: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-us-east-az1-node3 --context=prod`.
Riya (eng-sre): Starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-pool-us-east-az1-node3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
Ben (support): Sending customer advisory: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors in US-East and applying mitigations. Some long-context requests may be limited temporarily. We'll update in 15 minutes." Sent and tagged SLAs.
InfraBot: Incident metadata updated: priority=P1, impact=multi-customer, runbook=runtime-memory. Oncall: Nora (ack), Vik (ack), Riya (ack).
Vik (eng-runtime): Backtrace from one of the core dumps attached:
```
#0  0x00007f9aabbccdde in attention_forward_cuda at attention.cu:488
#1  0x00007f9aabbd0f2a in gpu_layer_forward at model_runtime.cu:1012
#2  0x00007f9aabbd2b1f in handle_request at runner.cpp:330
```
Vik (eng-runtime): This reproduces in internal stress harness when seq_len and batch_size are large; allocation path fails and we hit invalid memory access in attention kernel.
Riya (eng-sre): Node logs show host OOMs around the same timestamps. Cause likely combined GPU and host-memory pressure since we prefetch KV and maintain per-request buffers on host.
Nora (eng-oncall): After routing and env flags take effect, keep an eye on 5xx and latency. Any quick fixes beyond what we did?
Vik (eng-runtime): Additional quick wins: 1) temporarily disable prefetching of KV for long-context models 2) cap concurrent in-flight requests per-worker to reduce peak host allocations. I'll push those flags now.
Vik (eng-runtime): Applied: `kubectl set env ds/model-runner PREFETCH_KV=false MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_WORKER=2` -> restarting pods.
Riya (eng-sre): Drain completed for node3; node placed into maintenance. Collecting kernel and nv-host logs for postmortem.
Vik (eng-runtime): Observability: 5xx dropped from 25% -> 3.2% after route+flags, and after prefetch disable we're at 0.6%. Latency p95 increased ~+70ms due to reduced batching.
Nora (eng-oncall): Great. Ben, update customers: mitigations applied, errors resolving, slight latency increase for some endpoints. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem in 24h.
Ben (support): Customer messages sent. DataSense requested priority RCA call; scheduling.
Lola (product): Assign postincident owners: Vik + Riya for root-cause and mitigations. Product will collate customer impact and SLA hits.
Vik (eng-runtime): Post incident tasks I'll own: 1) Add bounds-check to attention kernel allocation path to fail gracefully before invalid read 2) implement mem-aware dynamic batching 3) add e2e tests for long-context flows 4) consider adaptive prefetch throttling.
Riya (eng-sre): SRE tasks: tune oom_score_adj for model-runner processes, increase node eviction thresholds on GPU hosts, add alert for kernel OOM frequency >3 in 10m.
Nora (eng-oncall): Incident marked mitigated. Keeping thread open for follow-ups and artifacts.
InfraBot: Incident RESOLVED by Nora (eng-oncall). Duration 00:32:49. Severity=P1. Follow-ups assigned. Link: https://internal.incidents/1930001111
Vik (eng-runtime): I'll open a CL for the attention kernel guardrails and schedule a canary rollout. Expect RFC within 6h.
Riya (eng-sre): Uploading collected logs and node diagnostics to ticket.
Nora (eng-oncall): Thanks all. If we see regressions, re-alert and escalate immediately. :white_check_mark:
